$comment: Hand-written purpose and exit-code notes for every command the READMEs list. Generator: scripts/docs/gen-command-table.mjs. Contract: `packages` must cover exactly the `scripts` of the root and of every apps/* package, no more and no less; `files` must name repository scripts that exist. A script with no note, a note naming a script that no longer exists, or a file entry pointing at a missing path makes the generator (and `node scripts/docs/check-public-docs.mjs`) fail. Text only; the generator owns the command column and the ordering.
